Neural quantum states · JAX

Variational Monte Carlo for quantum many-body systems.

The Greek word ταχύς (tachys) is an adjective meaning quick or swift.

Quickstart →
$ pip install tachys
Aim

Neural-network quantum states for realistic quantum materials

To reach the system sizes that real materials demand, tachys is optimized to scale across large GPU clusters.

↑↓

Spin systems

Spin-½ lattice models, benchmarked up to ~0 spins.

ψ

Fermionic systems

Fermionic lattice models, benchmarked up to 0 electrons, a scale already meaningful for unconventional superconductors.

S·s

Spins and fermions

Itinerant fermions and localized spins within a single Hamiltonian, as required by Kondo lattice models of heavy-fermion compounds.

∇

Foundation NQS

One network trained across an entire family of Hamiltonians, to explore the parameter space of a material in a single optimization.
